name: looming
citation: v1: one stimulus family (looming), walking-body readouts. Sides are dataset `side`.

set_citations.loom_left: LPLC2 is looming-selective: Klapoetke et al. 2017 Nature, doi:10.1038/nature24626. LC4 carries looming expansion velocity to the giant fibre: von Reyn et al. 2017 Neuron, doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2017.05.036. Both synapse directly onto the giant fibre: Ache et al. 2019 Curr Biol, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2019.01.079.
set_citations.loom_right: LPLC2 is looming-selective: Klapoetke et al. 2017 Nature, doi:10.1038/nature24626. LC4 carries looming expansion velocity to the giant fibre: von Reyn et al. 2017 Neuron, doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2017.05.036. Both synapse directly onto the giant fibre: Ache et al. 2019 Curr Biol, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2019.01.079.
set_citations.forward: DNp09 (P9) initiates forward walking, with an ipsilateral turning component (partial support: BPN is the straight-walking pathway): Bidaye et al. 2020 Neuron, doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2020.07.032.
set_citations.backward: MDN (moonwalker) activation is sufficient for backward walking: Bidaye et al. 2014 Science, doi:10.1126/science.1249964.
set_citations.turn_left: DNa02 is recruited on the side of the upcoming turn and unilateral activation biases steering ipsilaterally: Rayshubskiy et al. 2025 eLife, doi:10.7554/eLife.102230; unilateral DNa02 stimulation gives an ipsilateral turn: Yang et al. 2024 Cell, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2024.08.033.
set_citations.turn_right: DNa02 is recruited on the side of the upcoming turn and unilateral activation biases steering ipsilaterally: Rayshubskiy et al. 2025 eLife, doi:10.7554/eLife.102230; unilateral DNa02 stimulation gives an ipsilateral turn: Yang et al. 2024 Cell, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2024.08.033.
set_citations.escape: DNp01 is the giant fibre: Namiki et al. 2018 eLife, doi:10.7554/eLife.34272; it drives the looming escape take-off: von Reyn et al. 2017 Neuron, doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2017.05.036. FlyGym's walking body cannot take off; at Level A the decoder maps it to slowing (a modelling choice, not from the papers).
